tail.why: behind everything: it touches only the torso's back edge (its shade / stripe / cream bands go behind the body).

legFar.why: far leg: behind the body and behind the near leg (darker, it disappears under the belly).

legNear.why: behind the torso: the near leg's fur continues the torso's fur, the hip end will be hidden under the belly bottom.

armFar.why: far arm (v2): behind the torso (and the acorn); only its forearm + paw show in front of the belly line.

torso.why: body incl. collar; over the legs and tail, under the arm, pendant and head.

pendant.why: hangs on the collar front: in front of the torso.

armNear.why: near arm lies on the body side: in front of the torso (its top is tucked under the collar -> collar_front in step 5).

tuft.why: behind the head (front decision: flat tuft behind the head, base extended under it in step 5).

head.why: head's lower band overlaps the collar -> in front of the torso.

earNear.why: in front of the head: the ear covers the head's back stripe.

edge_alpha: front method (scripts/v2/step3_layers.py dewhite); armNear = exact step-1 arm layer
